title: Search noise multipliers using an accountant interface
prompt: Find the smallest approximate noise sigma meeting target epsilon via a supplied positive monotone-decreasing accountant(sigma). Bracket then bisect; return a feasible upper endpoint. The caller fixes sampling rate, steps, delta and adjacency in the accountant. Reject nonfinite evaluations/unreachable targets; this is not a mock privacy accountant.
